question:
Simplify

2.5 × [144 ÷ 198 × {121 × 81 ÷ (11 × 9)}]
solution:
Given:

2.5 × [144 ÷ 198 × {121 × 81 ÷ (11 × 9)}] 

Concept used:

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b20ef829d7a3ae933d09bfd6a40c70cdec29e481c3fb0ab1039424374e93fb79.png] 

Calculation:

2.5 × [144 ÷ 198 × {121 × 81 ÷ (11 × 9)}] 

⇒ 2.5 × [144 ÷ 198 × {121 × 81 ÷ 99}] 

⇒ 2.5 × [144 ÷ 198 × {99}] 

⇒ 2.5 × [72] 

⇒ 180

∴ The value is 180.
